reference_policy: reference/reference-0.* is the ORIGINAL public reference image, not a generated reconstruction. Compare directly with candidate/main.png. Alternate view only supports shape interpretation.
focus: Desk rows recede toward the board, with open aisles and right-window depth; retain the original wide classroom framing. Warm worn timber against muted walls and dark board, strong right-side daylight and directional desk shadows; text may be simplified.

anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.

targets.label: 黑板
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。按整块黑板及外框标注，包含较暗板面和底部托槽；不含上方字母条、灯条及旁侧公告栏。

targets.label: 椅子
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。每框对应一把可辨识椅子的全部可见部分，包括能够归属的椅背、座面和支架，不将课桌并入椅子。前景及左缘椅子被画面裁切；多把椅子的座面、椅腿被桌面或前排椅子遮挡，不推测隐藏轮廓。中央后排与右侧密集处的支架归属有一定不确定性；左上边缘孤立木片未另算实例。

targets.label: 窗户
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。按右墙三组完整窗框单元划分，包含各自窗扇、玻璃及百叶覆盖区域，不按小窗格拆分。中间和右侧窗户顶部出框，最右窗户右缘也被裁切；远端窄窗的边框受透视影响，边界略有不确定性。

targets.label: 顶灯
targets.review_note: 机器参考图标注，尚未人工校准。共四盏悬挂顶灯，按灯罩及可见吊线的整体范围标注，不包含光晕。黑板上方横向灯条属于壁面照明，未计入顶灯。

localization.detector_revision_note: Explicit mean token scores over frozen phrases with class/context competition. Single scale; larger detector and two-scale alternatives were rejected after reference-only review.
localization.public_scope: Reference boxes cover visible image extents, not inferred hidden geometry. Only the listed key objects enter localization; other scene content remains in the appearance component. Blackboard excludes the map, alphabet strip and bulletin boards. Windows are three visible full-height openings, not separate upper panes. Chair instance annotation/detection remains pending.
